name: Chichi Fetish 2 Tsundere I-Cup Race Queen Risa ~Chichi Sui Hen~
original_name: 乳フェチ2 ツンデレIcup レースクイーン理沙～乳吸い編～
source:
Risa is from a rich family. However, his parents suddenly declare bankruptcy and she can't pay the rent of her apartment. She starts working as a race queen and meets Ukyo, a racer. Ukyo hears her trouble and pays the rent for her. To repay it, Risa allows him to do Chichisui.... Like this, she gradually falls in love with Ukyo....

[From ErogeShop]
